display_long_description:
Kargil VR is an immersive tactical first-person shooter inspired by the events in mid 1999. Set in rugged Himalayan terrain, it shows the war between Pakistan and India from a neutral point of view. The game places you in the role of a soldier tasked with advancing through hostile environments, securing strategic locations, and completing critical objectives while facing determined enemy forces.

Players navigate steep mountains, rocky ridges, and remote outposts while engaging enemy soldiers in realistic firefights. A variety of weapons are available, including rifles, machine guns, sniper rifles, grenades, and other military equipment. Combat requires careful movement, use of cover, and accurate shooting to overcome enemy patrols and fortified positions.

The battlefield is dynamic and challenging, with enemy AI capable of detecting threats, taking cover, and coordinating attacks. Missions may involve defending key positions, capturing strategic areas, or eliminating hostile units. Players must adapt their tactics depending on the situation, whether advancing cautiously through enemy territory or responding to sudden attacks.

Kargil VR also features vehicles and support elements that add to the scale of combat. Helicopters and transport vehicles may appear during missions, delivering reinforcements or changing the flow of battle.
